question: Guru Gangadhar Pradhan Award is given in which field of art?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Guru Gangadhar Pradhan Award is specifically associated with the field of dance.
 
• This award commemorates the legacy of Guru Gangadhar Pradhan, a prominent figure in Indian classical dance, particularly in Odissi.
 
• It aims to recognize and honor outstanding contributions and achievements in the realm of dance.
 
• The award serves as an inspiration for artists to strive for excellence in their respective fields of dance.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Theatre
 Focuses on the performance of live actors on a stage, telling a story through dialogue, movement, music, and set design.
 
 

 Textile Art
 Encompasses art that is made from or involves textiles (fabric, yarn, etc.), including weaving, dyeing, and embroidery.
 
 

 Painting
 Refers to the practice of applying pigment to a surface (such as canvas, wood, paper) to create an image, scene, or abstract design.
